senses.gloss:
[kaṃsavadha_[?]]_
play. RASB. VII. 5374 (fr.).

[kaṃsāriśataka]]_
[by Gaṅgādāsa. See Gopālaśataka by a.

[kakṣimālikopaniṣad]
Oppert I. 7872. Mistake for Akṣaº

[kaṭhavallyupaniṣad]]_
[Adyar Up. p. 152. On wearing Ūrdhvapuṇḍra an. the seals of Viṣṇu's emblems on the arms.
Same a. Yajñopavītopaniṣad, p. 207 in Unpublished Upaniṣads, Adyar Library, 1933.
The last sentence in Adyar Up. p. 152 giving the name a. Kaṭhavallyupaniṣad is missing in the ptd. text.

[kathākośa]
Jain. contains Sthūlabhadracarita (684 v..), Vaṅkacūlakathā (78 v..) etc. America 5367.

[kathopodghāta]
[or upodghAtaprakaraNa] of Mudrārākṣasa. IO. 7122-3A. This is part of the beginning of the C. of Ḍhuṇḍhirāja on the play; see Telang's edn. p.. 42-44.

[kamalākara]
[
--Sudhīvilocana. Oppert I. 5222]. A mistake; for Sudhīº is Hārīta Veṅkaṭācārya's own C. on his Pitṛmedhasāra.

[kamalākarabhaṭṭa]
[son of Rāmakṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa, son of Nārasiṁha.
--Śāntikaumudī. C.. II. 364].
Nāraśiṁha, grand-father's name, seems to be a. error for Nārāyaṇa; the opening verse is identical with that of Śāntikamalākara of the well-known Kamalākara; C.. II. 364. has some other differences also with Śāntikamalākara.

[kayīṭabhaṭṭa]
[Q. in the spurious Śrāddhasāgara of Kullūka.] IHQ. XXVII. 1951, p.. 113 ff.

[karmaśaṅkara]
[
--Nītiviveka] Mistake for Karuṇāśaṅkara ? See Kṛpāśaṅkara an. Dayāº.

[kalaṅka]
[or kavikalaGka poet. Burnell 164b] another wrong title of kaGkaNa or kavikaGkaNa, a. of Mṛgāṅkaśataka. See TD. 3962.

[kalāpavyākaraṇa]dhātukāya
gr. Kātantra roots by Durgasiṁha. Cordier III. p. 508.
See also below under Kātantra, Dhātupāṭha.

[kalāpa]syādyantaprakriyā
gr. Kātantra. by Mañjukīrti. Cordier III. p. 962.

[kalāpa]syādyantasya_Prakriyāvicārita
gr. Kātantra. by Sarvadhara. Cordier III. p. 468.

[kalidūṣaṇa]
[by Ghanaśyāma; mentioned by his wives Sundarī an. Kamalā in their C. on Viddhasālabhañjikā (TD. 4678)]. It is only Act two of Ḍamaruka. MER. 1889 para 15. See IHQ. XIX. p. 244.

[kaliyanrahasya]
[śrīvaiṣ. mentioned in Divyaprabandhanigamanavacanāni, MT. 2239 (d). A Tamil work.]

[kalpayukti]
[by Budha or Buddha. Q. in Mallinātha's C. on Kumāraº I. 24. on the source of Vaiḍūrya].
This passage q. by Mallinātha is found in ptd. edns. without the work-name Kalpayukti; actually the verse is in Buddhabhaṭa's Ratnaparīkṣā, Vaiḍūrya section, verse 2, Madras Govt. Ori. Mss. Library, edn. 1951, p. 49.

[kalpāraga]
[mistake for the a. name Kalyāṇa.
--Bālatantra. BORI. 593 of 1899-1915.
See Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. II. p.. 114-21].

[kalyāṇanāndi_[?]
Hombucca 195]. Mistake for Kalyāṇamandirastotra ?

[kalyāṇasūtra]
[Oxf. 100b]. Mistake for Kalyāṇaputra, i. e. Kalyāṇa, son of Mahīdhara.

[kavikalaṅka]
[Burnell 164b].
See Kavikaṅkaṇa.

[kavisārvabhauma]
[
--Yogānandaprahasana. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 73.]
This evidently refers to Aruṇagirinātha, a. of Somavallīyogānandaprahasana.
See NCC. I. p. 276a. [Page287-b]

[kāñcana]darpaṇa
name of Śivarāma Tripāṭhin's C. on Subandhu's Vāsavadattā.
Pt.. F. Hall, Calcutta, 1859. Bib. Ind. 30; Jivananda Vidyasagar, Calcutta, 1874.
For a study of the C., see L. Gray, JAOS. XXIV. i. 1908, p.. 57-63.
But the C. is called simply Darpaṇa; no basis for the adjunct ‘Kāñcana’.

[kātyāyanītantra]
[by Nāgeśa]. Oudh IX. 20.
This is evidently the Devīmāhātmyavidhāna a. from Kātyāyanītantra reproduced in his C. on Devīmāhātmya. [Page332-a.

[kādimatatantra]
[
--C. Setubandha by Bhāskara. C.. V. 44. K. 56].
See Nityāṣoḍaśikārṇava an. C. thereon.

[kāmakalā]
[by Kokka or Kokkoka. Nepal I. p. 82. Rep. Hpr. I. p. 11. wrong entry for Ratirahasya].

[kāyastha]jātinirṇaya
dh. Baroda 11003.

[kārakaṭīkā]
[gr. by Gopīcandra. Adyar II. p. 83a. See Goyīcandra's C. on Saṁkṣiptasāra, Kāraka section. Adyar D. VI. 709].

[kārakārthaprakāśikā]
[MD. 1507 (inc.). 1508 (inc.). Wrong title for Kārakārthapradīpikā by Sudarśanācārya]. [Page379-a.

[kārakāvali]
[gr. by Bhaṭṭoji Dīkṣita. Mithilā.
See Kārikās by Bhaṭṭoji].

[kārikāvivaraṇa]
[by Nandikeśvara. Ujjain II. p. 37]. Correct title Kāśikāº.

[kāladīpa]
[by Narasiṁha. PUL. II. p. 212 (with Tamil C.). Same a. Kālaprakāśikā of Nṛsiṁha].

[kālanirṇaya]
[by Toṭakācārya. Burnell 139b. Wrong entry for Tithinirṇaya by Timmaṇācārya. See TD. 18588]. [Page024-b]

[kālākṣa]
[preceptor of Paraśurāma, a. of Bhūpālavallabha stotra, BORI. 444 of Ā881-82]. Mistake for Kaṭākṣa. See NCC. III. p. 392b.

[kālāyudhanighaṇṭu]
[lex. Gough p. 143. mistake for Halāyudhanighaṇṭu ?]

[kālī(bhadrakālī)keliyātrābhāṇa]
[MD. 12512. Trav. Uni. L. 185B. Same a. Rasasadanabhāṇa by Godavarman of Cranganore].

[kāvajī]
[ref. in L. 2243]. wrong entry for Kāhnajī.

[kāverīstotra]
[beg. kAverImavagAhiSIya etc. MT. 3501 (a.].
This is not a. independent work, but forms verses 20-27 of the Pūrvaśataka of Śrīraṅgarājastava by Parāśara Bhaṭṭa.

[kāvyakalpalatā]
[--C. Kalpapallava. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 25].
See also ibid. p. 77. Extr. no. 18. Wrong title; work same a. Kalpalatā, [Page086-b] NCC. III. p. 237a, last but one entry.

[kāvyādilakṣaṇa]
[alaṁk.] MT. 5578 (a. (inc.). Restored from MD. 12829. Same a. Kāvyadarpaṇa by Rājacūḍāmaṇi Dīkṣita.

[kāvyālaṅkārasūtra]
[ascribed to Yāska] with Vaidikabhāṣya by Akhilānanda Śarman. [Page114-b] Meerut, 1914. (Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk. 1906-28. 1163. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1317). Really Vāmana's K. a. sūtras, falsely attributed to Yāska here.

[kāśikāstava]
[by Nandikeśvara. BORI. D. IX. i. 197 (with C.).]
Same a. Nandikeśvarakāśikā.

[kāśyapa_abhinavakālidāsa]
[C.. I. 106b; kAzyapI son of Appayya, Grahaceṣtāvidhāna. Triv. Cur. III. 40; kAzyapaveGkaTeza Dinaphala. TD. XX. Sup. no. 1016 (t)].
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p.. 258b an. 259a, Appaya an. Bhūgola Veṅkaṭeśa, of Kāśyapa gotra.
